name: Saudi Arabia via Yanbu
route_description: Yanbu port → Suez Canal → Indian Ocean
source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: East-West (Petroline) pipeline bypass capacity ~5-7 mb/d (EIA Saudi Arabia country analysis); India share assumed ~10% of bypass headroom.

name: UAE via Fujairah
source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: ADCOP Habshan-Fujairah pipeline nameplate 1.5 mb/d (EIA UAE country analysis); Fujairah loads outside the Strait, so the route transits no modelled corridor.

name: Kuwait via Shuaiba
route_description: Shuaiba port → Suez Canal → Indian Ocean
source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: Kuwait has no Hormuz bypass pipeline; figure kept small for that reason.
note: GEOGRAPHY CAVEAT: Shuaiba is inside the Persian Gulf, so crude loaded there must physically transit Hormuz. The committed claim avoids_corridor=Hormuz is PRESERVED so results stay comparable with CLAUDE.md's alternative table; treat this row's Hormuz eligibility with suspicion.

name: Iraq via Ceyhan
source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline, restarted 2025 at a fraction of its ~0.9 mb/d nameplate (EIA Iraq country analysis).

name: USA WTI
route_description: Gulf Coast → Cape of Good Hope → Indian Ocean
source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: US Gulf Coast export capacity is large; limit is freight/arbitrage economics at a 28-day voyage (EIA US crude exports).

name: Nigeria Bonny Light

source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: West African light sweet cargoes spot-available to Asia (EIA Nigeria country analysis).

name: Angola Girassol
route_description: Angolan terminal → Atlantic → Cape → Indian Ocean
source: ESTIMATE, not reconciled against a PPAC/IEA balance: West African spot cargoes; Angola output is in structural decline (EIA Angola country analysis).

name: Russia Urals

note: SANCTIONS: flag set true to match CLAUDE.md's alternative table ('Partial' - G7 price cap / EU restrictions). Excluded from reroute by default; visible with include_sanctioned. Negative premium (-$3) would otherwise place it at cost_score 1.0.
